notes.title: Whispers of the Dead Patch 1.0.04
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Another small patch, putting out the fires that I can as they come. Still working on other feedback items. Here is an overview of what's been added/patched:

Gameplay Update

- Gun can now be aimed lower (Destroy those pesky and annoying radios)
- Raised Leviathan Laugh by 20% more

Level Edits

- Adam's Apartment Part II: Added New Note
- Adam's Apartment Part II: Fixed Alarm
- The Long Walk Home III: Continue Now Leads To New Prompt

Bug Fix

- Investigate Kitchen Window now clears
- Start From Hunt in menu two now brings you too the actual hunt

Please reach out with any questions, concerns, or issues either in the Megathread in the discussions area or email me at projectflifegame@gmail.com
Thank you for taking time to play Whispers of the Dead. Ill see you tomorrow with another update.

- Michael Colvin

notes.title: Whispers of the Dead Patch 1.0.03
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Been doing what I can to put out the fires as they come in. Feedback has been helpful, and doing all I can to try and fix bugs and complaints. Here is an overview of what's been added/patched today:

Level Fixes

- Added trigger event if you get past Mammon (Good Job)

QOL Fixes

- Leviathan laugh raised by 20%
- Warning Before Quitting
- Tutorial/Practice Mode
- Note Before Start of Hunt
- Changed Music on Credits
- Adjusted Camera Lag
- Added Start From Hunt Option

Option Additions

- Temporary Resolution Settings (Will Be Expanded Soon)

Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where completing Act II achievement would not unlock.
- Turning off Pause Menu During Credits

For all those struggling through, my apologies for the state of things. The feedback, positive and negative has been appreciated and I'm looking into doing all that I can to make Whispers of the Dead the game you were looking for, not the game that it is.

Please reach out with any questions, concerns, or issues either in the Megathread in the discussions area or email me at projectflifegame@gmail.com

Thank you for taking time to play Whispers of the Dead. Ill see you tomorrow with another update.

- Michael Colvin
